# Depot Übersicht

<!-- charter:prose:start -->
## Summary

Die Depot-Planung Nord bündelt Lieferkette und Übergabe an einem Ort — persona: dana-dispatcher.
Sie nennt es „Depot-Planung Nord“ … und meint damit den ganzen Ablauf.

## Purpose and background

Who plans the depots is described in [the persona registry](../personas.md#dana-dispatcher), and the principles
behind the product are on [the philosophy page](../explanation/philosophy.md).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Übergabe before Lieferkette: a handover that is late is worse than a route that is long.

## Direction changes

- 2026-11-02 — the depot list moved from a spreadsheet to this document.
